Data table contains the following: [Forcibly displaced] - Palestine refugees under UNRWA's mandate

Description:

Extracted from: Refugee Data Finder, United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees

Last updated: 04/11/2026 08:08

Some data presented may differ from statistics published previously due to retroactive changes or the inclusion of previously unavailable data.

Content type:
End year stock population totals
[

	Flow figures, updated six monthly:
		For asylum applications and decisions, IDP returnees, refugee returnees, resettlement arrivals and naturalization: total flows during each year [Add the switch for mid-year if needed: The data for the latest year ([YEAR]) is available up until the mid-year]

	Stock estimates, updated montly:
		For nowcasting: the latest estimated population totals, updated monthly

	Flow figures, updated monthly:
		For resettlement submissions: [total or "demographics of"] flows during each year, including the cumulative total during the current year
		For resettlement departures: total flows during each year, including the cumulative total during the current year

	Estimated annual flow figures:
		For resettlement needs: Estimated population totals during each year

	Stock figures, updated six monthly:
		For other datasets (UNHCR population statistics, UNRWA and IDMC): End year [stock/flow] population [totals / demographics] [Add the switch for mid-year if needed (i.e. if the dataset is available for mid-year and it is NOT IDMC): The data for the latest year ([YEAR]) is available up until the mid-year]

]
